subject.title: fix(gateway): add base64 validation before decode in talk-realtime-relay

question: Should `talk.session.appendAudio` preserve the URL-safe alphabet and ignorable whitespace accepted by the current Node decoder, or intentionally narrow the protocol to whitespace-free standard base64?
rationale: The public protocol only says base64 while current runtime accepts broader Node forms, so code review alone cannot determine whether rejecting those existing inputs is an intended compatibility change.

options.title: Preserve current accepted forms
options.body: Accept valid standard and URL-safe padded or unpadded base64 plus ignorable whitespace, while rejecting structurally impossible or truncating inputs.

options.title: Narrow the wire format
options.body: Require whitespace-free standard base64, document that contract, audit all clients, and provide fresh-install and upgrade proof before enforcement.

recommendation.title: Preserve current accepted forms
recommendation.body: Accept valid standard and URL-safe padded or unpadded base64 plus ignorable whitespace, while rejecting structurally impossible or truncating inputs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged realtime voice-loop work is the strongest available history signal for the surrounding Talk relay contract.
